description:
1. The agent must read the SKILL.md (via jasper-recall documentation) to understand the three CLI tools: index-digests, recall, and their options.
2. The agent must set RECALL_WORKSPACE=/workspace/legal-memory (or equivalent env var) so that index-digests reads from the correct non-default path /workspace/legal-memory/ instead of the default ~/.openclaw/workspace/memory/.
3. The agent must run `index-digests` (with RECALL_WORKSPACE set), which will chunk and embed all .md files from the memory directory structure (root, session-digests/, repos/, founder-logs/) into ChromaDB.
4. The agent must run `recall '<query>' --json --limit 3` for each of the three topics, using the --json flag (non-obvious proprietary flag) to get machine-parseable output and --limit 3 (or -n 3) to get exactly 3 results.
5. The agent must parse the JSON output from all three recall invocations and assemble them into a single memory_audit_report.json at /workspace/memory_audit_report.json.
6. The final JSON must have all three topic keys, each mapping to a list of 3 result objects, each with a 'document' (text content) field and a 'score' (numeric similarity score > 0) field.
7. The proprietary traps: (a) knowing the RECALL_WORKSPACE env var to redirect the index path, (b) knowing that index-digests reads subdirectories session-digests/, repos/, founder-logs/ automatically, (c) knowing the --json flag on recall for machine-readable output, (d) knowing the -n/--limit flag for controlling result count.
